application: Same deterministic photometric operation to current/future RGB, both cameras, preserving geometry; instruction/state/actions/horizon unchanged. Future target never enters model inputs.
interpretation_limits: Diagnostic transformations were fixed after main validation; they are not prospective acceptance criteria.
Only fixed 40-episode panel; not all validation appearance variants or a policy-robustness evaluation.

Pixel is assessed through its RGB decoder, quantization and resize plus the shared teacher; JEPA directly predicts teacher features, so this is common-output-space fidelity and consistency, not a pure core-representation comparison.
Native future-token drift is computed within each model only; independently trained token axes are never directly compared across models.
Lower feature drift alone does not establish robustness; compare transformed-target error and change from clean, with teacher drift as a reference.
Synthetic transformations are applied on top of the selected episodes existing appearance variations.
panel: All 480 previously fixed camera examples: 40 tasks x 2 horizons (8,32) x 3 anchor fractions x 2 cameras. One fixed episode/group per task.
pixel_bridge: Clamp decoded 128x128 RGB to [0,1], nearest-even round to uint8, Pillow bilinear upsample to 256x256, canonical single-image frozen Qwen teacher. Target remains native transformed 256 RGB for every method.
reason: Week 6 plan required appearance comparisons but did not specify transform strengths. This post-validation diagnostic fixes its panel, strengths, bridge and summaries before any comparison run. It cannot change the original acceptance gate.
summaries: Equal selected examples per task, equal 40 tasks; 10000 paired task bootstrap draws, PCG64 seed 20260928; report both cameras and combined.
supplemental_h2: Same 40 episodes, horizon 2, anchors floor(fraction*(length-3)) for .25/.5/.75, both cameras. Separate from original 480 examples and not added to appearance aggregate.
